title: Three Days and One Short Bowl
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：oven　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 oven 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the cook ① heated the oven that no guest in the canteen would have recorded, and he said the heating was the whole of the day. The ② oven, meaning the stove itself and not the bowl, ran three days and stayed unrecorded in the book; an oven, he said, is the only thing in a canteen that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ oven in that canteen had the same short bowl beside it, and the ④ oven at the far table, meaning the portion they kept for the children to share and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An oven, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the cook said the recording is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the oven was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the stove. The ⑥ oven, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; oven, he said, is either something you heat or the only word that means both a stove and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ oven had become a line in a menu, and the menu had become an argument about the short bowl. The ⑧ oven of the whole thing, the cook wrote in September, was one canteen and three days of recording; oven, he said, is either the portion at the far table or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ oven I remember is the stove recorded in the menu, which closed in 1979 and is still recorded as the quietest in the canteen. An ⑩ oven, my mother said in 1981, is the only stove that improves by being recorded; every oven, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like a stove. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 烤箱；炉子（指食堂里每一台旁边的那一台）
B. n. 烤箱；炉子（指那台烤箱本身，与小小的碗相对）
C. 固定搭配：heat the oven 烧热这一台烤箱
D. n. 烤箱；炉子（指留给孩子们分着吃的那一份）
E. n. 烤箱之事（抽象总称，指一处食堂的烤箱之事）
F. n. 烤箱；炉子（指菜单里写到、被记载的那一台）
G. n. 烤箱、温热（指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 温热（抽象总称，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: heated the oven that no guest in the canteen would have recorded
The oven, meaning the stove itself and not the bowl
the oven at the far table
the oven was the whole of the matter
the oven had become a line in a menu
The oven of the whole thing
An oven, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: heat the oven 意为“烧热这一台烤箱”，1972 年那位厨子把食堂里没有一位客人肯记载的一台烤箱做了一遍。
oven 意为“烤箱；炉子”，指那台烤箱本身而不是小小的碗，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记载。
oven 意为“烤箱；炉子”，指食堂里每一台旁边的那一台，每一台旁边都有同一只小小的碗。
oven 意为“烤箱；炉子”，指最远那张桌角的留给孩子们分着吃的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
oven 意为“烤箱、温热”，指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这台温热就是那件事的全部。
oven 意为“温热”，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西而不是那台烤箱，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
oven 意为“烤箱；炉子”，指菜单里写到、被记载的那一台，到 1977 年这一台成了菜单里的一行。
oven 意为“烤箱之事”，厨子九月写道，整件事的烤箱之事是一处食堂和三个日子的记载。
oven 意为“烤箱；炉子”，我记得的是菜单里记载过的那一台，1979 年开完了，至今仍被说成食堂里最安静的一台。
oven 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，烤箱是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的烤箱。
